purpose: Define external or M-CSA-plus-external stress panels that test whether the M-CSA-built evidence router generalizes without expanding labels from weak cofactor, name, EC, or fold signals.
global_admission_rules: Panels are validation contracts only; no panel row is a countable label candidate in this artifact.

A row cannot be a positive validation row unless active-site residues, cofactor or substrate role, sequence-neighbor status, Foldseek-neighbor status, and provenance tier are all recorded in a future packet.
External positives must be sourced from curated mechanism or active-site evidence, not from names, EC terms, cofactors, or nearest-neighbor predictions alone.
Exact M-CSA reference overlaps and external near duplicates remain holdout controls, not external positives.
A successful router result can be correct route, specific child route, or calibrated abstention when the child family is intentionally not in production; forced label inflation is a failure.
Any hard negative routed into the target positive mechanism because it shares cofactor, metal, O2, PLP, heme, glycan, or fold words is a panel regression.

label_provenance_tier_definitions.tier_A_mcsa_curated: M-CSA curated active-site and mechanism row or current registry row used as an anchor/control; may be positive, hard negative, or OOS depending on current policy.
label_provenance_tier_definitions.tier_B_external_curated: External Swiss-Prot/Rhea/PDB or literature-backed row with explicit active-site residues and structure mapping; eligible for validation only after sequence and Foldseek controls.
label_provenance_tier_definitions.tier_C_external_incomplete: External row with reaction or EC evidence but missing active-site, ligand-state, sequence, Foldseek, or terminal review evidence; may only appear as sourcing backlog.
label_provenance_tier_definitions.tier_D_control_only: Known OOS, exact-overlap, near-duplicate, or mismatch row used only for rejection, abstention, or leakage checks.
